svg.text: a text game (GO EAST, SHOOT WEST) hunting a Wumpus in caverns while avoiding traps
and pits; a UI, rules and storage seem enough, but language is one axis of change
(Fig 25.1) and the mechanism of text delivery another (Fig 25.3)
each API is defined and owned by the user, not the implementer: GameRules defines
the Language API, Language implements it; Language defines the TextDelivery API,
TextDelivery implements it (dashed boxes are abstract API components)
Fig 25.4: all arrows (source dependencies) point up. Input rises from the user through TextDelivery and Language into GameRules; output goes down the same stream. Two
streams (communicating with the user; persistence) meet at the top in GameRules, the old Central Transform. A multiplayer version adds a network component, making three
